front.intro: The work on this East End bungalow started below the floor, where the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before anything else went in. The wiring and the breaker box are new, along with the plumbing, and three-phase power is wired to the panel. Hardi Plank siding and a new roof finish the outside, and the driveway and the fence are new too. Inside, the Kitchen and both baths are new, and the wood-look floors continue through the whole house with no thresholds between rooms.

top.kicker: The floor plan and the front rooms
top.title: The complete layout, room by room
top.planNote: Approximate and not to scale. The buyer verifies every room size and every label on the plan before relying on them.

left.name: Front Entry
left.text: The front door is stained wood with glass panes across the top, and the Living Room starts right behind it. A large window on the left wall looks out to the front yard. The Kitchen peninsula is visible from the door.

left.name: Breakfast Bar
left.text: Two pendant lights hang over the Kitchen peninsula, with room for barstools along the counter. The marble-look counters and backsplash continue around the L, so the peninsula matches the rest of the Kitchen.

right.name: Dining Area
right.text: The Dining area is the link between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. A cased opening on the front side joins it to the Living Room. A round table fits here with space to pull out the chairs.

right.name: Breakfast Nook
right.text: Windows on two walls bring daylight into the Breakfast Nook, and the Kitchen counter wraps one side of the room. A door on the back wall leads out to the rear deck, the fenced yard and the covered patio.

photo.name: Covered Patio and Garage
photo.text: The covered patio and the covered garage stand side by side across the back of the fenced yard. The garage is wide and deep enough to park under, to work in or to set up for a crowd. String lights are already up under the patio roof.

bottom.title: The Primary, the bedrooms and the baths

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: The Primary is at the back of the house, away from the street, with a vaulted ceiling and an exposed painted beam overhead. It is the largest bedroom in the house. The hall to the other bedrooms is a few steps away.

items.name: Primary Bath
items.text: A dark navy double-sink vanity stands under a wide LED backlit mirror. The glass shower has full-height marble-look tile, a rain showerhead and a handheld. A doorway on the Primary's closet wall opens straight into the bath.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Serving Bedrooms 2 and 3 and guests, this bath has a tub with marble-look tile that goes all the way up the wall. A pebble tile niche is set into the tile wall. An LED mirror hangs over the sink. Both bedrooms are a few steps away.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: A built-in shelving tower stands in the middle, with hanging rods along both sides. Shelves above the rods hold bins or luggage. The built-ins stay with the house. Both doors swing open to show the whole closet at once.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: Windows on two walls light the larger of the two secondary bedrooms, which is at the front corner of the house. It and Bedroom 3 share the hall bath. The Primary is across the house, so the two rooms stay well apart.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet is on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The carpet is new. It is between Bedroom 2 and the Primary, on the same hall. A wide window on the side wall lights the room through the day.

back.title: Living Room and Kitchen, with the Dining area between

items.name: Living Room
items.text: A wide cased opening joins the Living Room to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so the whole front of the house reads as one space. A clerestory window high on the wall brings in daylight and keeps the room private from the street. Wood-look floors carry through without a threshold, from the front door to the Kitchen.

items.name: Kitchen
items.text: The Kitchen is all new, laid out in an L with a peninsula that faces the Dining area. A stainless range stands under a chimney hood, with the sink under the window and a stainless dishwasher beside it. A pair of pendants hangs over the peninsula, which has room for barstools. Wood-look floors continue from the Dining area.

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, from the listing's floor plan. Living area per HCAD.

a.text: On this East End bungalow the front gable is board and batten, over a stained wood door and a covered stoop. A wide cased opening links the Living Room, the Dining area and the L-shaped Kitchen. The Primary has a vaulted ceiling. Behind the house, a covered garage and a covered patio share the fenced yard, with string lights overhead.

caps.a: Big front windows face the yard, with a narrow one up high. The cased opening leads straight on to the Dining area.

jl.front9: Board and batten covers the front gable over a stained wood door. Inside, a wide cased opening joins the Living Room, Dining area and L-shaped Kitchen. Behind the house sit a garage a little over 24 feet deep and a patio just under 26 feet long, and both of them are covered.

jl.about9: The nook sits beside the Kitchen with windows on two walls, and the peninsula has room for barstools. The hall bath has marble-look tile up to the ceiling and a pebble tile niche. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner, and Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side, which leaves the window wall free for a desk. The driveway out front is new, Hardi Plank siding covers the outside and the laundry is inside the house.
jl.about11: The nook sits beside the Kitchen with windows on two walls, and the peninsula has room for barstools. The hall bath has marble-look tile up to the ceiling and a pebble tile niche, and open linen shelves stand just outside it. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner of the house, and Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side, which leaves the window wall free for a desk. The driveway out front is new, Hardi Plank siding covers the outside, and the laundry is inside the house. A new roof tops it, and a deck runs off the nook, with wide white steps down to the grass.

js.front9: I listed this house with photos of every room, a floor plan and a printed brochure in buyers' hands at the first showing. I walked the sellers through each offer line by line, kept the inspection and the appraisal on schedule, and called them every week, then I handed over the keys at the closing table myself.

You'll leave with a written plan for photos, showings and timing, and we'll set a list date that suits you. It takes about an hour at your kitchen table, on a weekday evening or a Saturday morning, whichever is easier for you, and I'll answer every question you've saved up.
